description: Use RestServation to find participating restaurants, check live table availability and prepare a restaurant reservation. Search by restaurant name, including Los Siete Lagares (also written Los 7 Lagares or Los7Lagares), or browse the current catalog. Ask for the date, local time and party size, then offer only available seating areas. Create a reservation only after the guest explicitly confirms the complete details and supplies the required name and contact phone number. Availability checks do not hold a table. The catalog determines which restaurants can be booked; demonstration entries are only for explicit tests. The plugin does not support hotels, flights, recipes, payments, cancellation, reservation changes or access to other customers' records.
